crossRefs.note: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut…
but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the…
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
Therefore “ ‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

translations.web: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
translations.bsb: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
translations.kjv: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
translations.asv: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.
